c.tagline: French colonial port on the world's second-largest natural bay, gateway to Madagascar's wild north.

taxi.fareNote: No ride-hailing apps operate here. Shared taxis-be (minibuses) run fixed routes across town for a few hundred ariary, while private taxis are unmetered — agree the fare before setting off.

emergency.note: Emergency response outside the main towns is very limited; carry a local SIM and keep your lodge's direct number handy.

avoid.reason: Avoid the port area and unlit streets anywhere in town after dark, as muggings occur.
Keep phones and jewelry out of sight in the market and along beaches, and use a trusted driver rather than walking at night.

hood_desc: The historic lower colonial town along the seafront and port, home to the Bazary Be market, faded French mansions, and the promenade over the great bay; the walkable heart for first-time visitors.
The lively main artery climbing through the upper town, lined with the city's best restaurants, bars, hotels, and tour operators; where evenings and nightlife concentrate.
A dense, workaday residential district set back from the water, with local markets and cheap eateries; authentic and inexpensive but short on sights.
A laid-back fishing-and-beach village about 18 km east, the launch point for the Emerald Sea (Mer d'Émeraude) and Sakalava Bay; palm-lined sand, seafood shacks, and small beach hotels.
A quieter residential and expat-leaning neighborhood on the town's outskirts near the old SCAMA estate; calm and green, better for longer stays with a car.

water.note: Drink bottled or treated water only.

transit.hours: Taxi-be run roughly 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM; after dark private taxis are the only option.
transit.note: Antsiranana has no formal bus, tram, or rail network. Shared taxis-be (minibuses) ply fixed routes across town, supplemented by private unmetered taxis.
transit.pay: Pay the taxi-be conductor in cash on board (a few hundred ariary per ride); private taxi fares are negotiated before departure. No transit cards exist.

bus: Shared taxi-be minibuses within the city
Taxi-brousse (long-distance bush taxis) to Ambanja, Ambilobe and beyond
ferry: Small boats to Ramena and around the bay

transit.m: Private taxi to the town centre (10-15 min)

tip.r: Not obligatory; rounding up or leaving 5-10% for good service in tourist restaurants is appreciated.
